name: MacOS
description: Mac vibes, zero install. Boot it up, get through setup, drag windows around, and forget you’re still in a browser.

name: Latent Hub
description: Built because watching Latent shouldn't feel harder than watching Netflix. Faster loads, cleaner playback, and less clutter between you and the episode.

name: SoulOS
description: Linux freedom, macOS polish, and Windows familiarity—all in one ridiculously smooth web OS preview.

name: Lossify
description: Music streaming for people who actually care about audio quality. Hi-res tracks, smooth UI, and zero unnecessary noise getting between you and the music.

name: Presence
description: Because nobody wants to calculate attendance percentages manually at 2AM before internals. Presence keeps track of everything so you don't have to.

name: Omnibypass
description: 15-second timers are annoying. Omnibypass skips the fake waiting game and gets you to the actual link instantly.

name: Frontend Skills Vault
description: A growing collection of UI/UX components, frontend layouts, and web experiments made for frontend developers who want to build faster, learn by doing, and get better results.

name: Solitaired
description: A royal take on classic Klondike. Play Draw 1 or Draw 3, try a Daily Deal, and keep track of your high scores on a green-and-gold card table.

name: SyncLab
description: No more yelling “3, 2, 1, play” in the group chat. SyncLab keeps everyone's music in sync while friends queue songs, vote, and fight over who gets DJ mode.

name: PS5 UI
description: I thought the PS5 dashboard looked cool, so I rebuilt it in the browser using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript just to see if I could.

name: Portfolio
description: The place where everything lives. Projects, experiments, and whatever I'm currently obsessed with building.

name: AI Watermark Master Skill
description: A structured collection of rules, prompts, and patterns designed to clean up AI outputs and remove unwanted structural watermarks.

name: Xcloud Keyboard/Mouse
description: Xbox Cloud Gaming flat out refuses to run on PC without a controller plugged in. This extension hooks into the browser's HTML5 Gamepad API and translates your keyboard and mouse input into virtual controller signals on the fly, so you can finally play the way you want.

name: ProTrack
description: A simple way to track rural athletes' progress, wins, and milestones without the messy paperwork. It keeps a digital record of everything in one place, so nothing gets lost.
